checks.invariant: same_origin verifies both scheme and host origin on cookie-authenticated browser endpoints and rejects missing or downgraded-scheme Origin headers
checks.result: Bounded sandboxed TestClient tests verified that same_origin() evaluates True for 'http://testserver' against https endpoints and True when Origin is omitted entirely, successfully allowing POST /logout (303) and POST /ui/approvals/approve (200) cross-scheme. Origin: null and cross-domain origins (evil.com) are rejected with 403.

checks.invariant: Cookie security attributes and proxy headers enforce secure transport and prevent downgraded cross-scheme session abuse
checks.result: DesktopControl sets SameSite=Strict and Secure cookies when TLS is detected, but same_origin lacks access to the request scheme. deploy/Caddyfile configures reverse_proxy without Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), leaving origin validation vulnerable to cross-scheme requests if browser SameSite policy permits.

checks.invariant: Unauthenticated clients cannot trigger body reading or JSON parsing beyond 64 KiB across any endpoint, and /login enforces a 64 KiB cap
checks.result: Sandboxed TestClient execution demonstrated that _BodyLimit evaluates authenticated() before reading body bytes. Unauthenticated 2MB requests to /sandboxes/sb_x/tools/exec, requests with invalid Bearer tokens, deleted sandbox tokens, and malformed cookies all return 401 with 0 JSON decode operations. POST /login allows <= 64 KiB and returns 413 for > 64 KiB. POST /login/ returns 401 without reading body.

checks.invariant: Control plane enforces concurrency limits, proxy body caps, and container memory limits to prevent pre-authentication resource amplification
checks.result: Source inspection confirms max_connections (default 256) is passed as limit_concurrency to uvicorn in cli.py, deploy/Caddyfile enforces 8MiB max_size on @other and 256MB on @upload, and deploy/docker-compose.yml sets mem_limit to 2g.

candidates.title: Scheme-blind Origin netloc comparison allows cross-scheme CSRF against cookie-authenticated routes
candidates.description: same_origin compares only the netloc of the Origin header with the Host header and accepts missing Origin headers. When agentbox is deployed behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (such as Caddy) without HSTS, or on a host with co-located HTTP services, requests originating from an insecure http:// scheme on the same host match the netloc check and can perform state-changing operations (such as session termination via /logout or approval decisions via /ui/approvals) using the browser's session cookie.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: agentbox/api.py:221-223: same_origin() returns True when urlsplit(origin).netloc == headers.get('host') or when Origin is absent. The closure receives only headers and does not verify whether the Origin scheme matches the request scheme (e.g., https). deploy/Caddyfile:1-17 does not set Strict-Transport-Security, so plain-HTTP contexts on the same host are not upgraded to HTTPS by the browser.

trace.description: Browser submits a cross-scheme POST /logout (or other state-changing browser route like /ui/approvals/{aid}/approve) from an http:// origin on the same host.
same_origin() extracts the Origin header, parses netloc with urlsplit, and compares it to Host, ignoring the http vs https scheme mismatch.
Session cookie is configured with SameSite=Strict and Secure, leaving protection against cross-scheme requests dependent on browser-level Schemeful Same-Site enforcement.
Reverse proxy config lacks Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), allowing insecure plaintext HTTP access on the same host to persist.

evidence.description: same_origin() evaluates 'not origin or urlsplit(origin).netloc == headers.get("host")'. Scheme is not compared, and absent Origin evaluates to True.
screen_principal() validates incoming browser requests using same_origin(request.headers), allowing downgraded-scheme requests to authenticate.
Caddy reverse proxy passes requests without injecting Strict-Transport-Security headers, allowing plaintext HTTP on the same host.

blockers: Live browser verification is required to determine whether real-world Chromium, Firefox, and Safari browsers enforce Schemeful Same-Site policy strictly enough to suppress 'SameSite=Strict; Secure' cookies on cross-scheme (http:// to https://) requests against the same domain or localhost.

Verification on a live Docker deployment with Caddy reverse proxy to confirm whether port 80 HTTP traffic can trigger session termination (/logout) or administrative actions (/ui/approvals) via cross-scheme forgery in the absence of HSTS.

validation_plan.local: Start agentbox locally behind an HTTPS proxy using dummy session cookies. Using a browser (Chromium and Firefox), load a page served from http://localhost and trigger a fetch/form POST to https://localhost/logout and https://localhost/ui/approvals/{aid}/approve. Observe whether the browser attaches the agentbox_session cookie and whether the server processes the request with status 303/200.
validation_plan.deployment: Deploy the official stack via deploy/docker-compose.yml with Caddy. Authenticate an administrative browser session over HTTPS. Navigate to an insecure HTTP site on the same host/domain and attempt a cross-scheme POST to /logout or an approval endpoint. Observe whether the session is terminated or the approval processed without origin rejection.

hardening: authenticated() in api.py:193-199 catches CookieError when parsing Cookie headers with SimpleCookie, failing closed by returning False (401) on malformed cookies.
Trailing slash variations like POST /login/ are not included in _ANON_BODY_PATHS, so unauthenticated requests receive 401 before body read rather than bypassing the 64 KiB cap.

deploy/docker-compose.yml sets a 2g mem_limit on the agentbox-control container, and cli.py enforces uvicorn limit_concurrency based on AGENTBOX_MAX_CONNECTIONS (default 256), bounding simultaneous in-flight connections.
